raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ about so. , ( colloq ) tergila-gilakan sso: she’s ~ about him, dia tergila-gilakan lelaki itu; ~ about st, gila sst: he’s ~ about music, dia gila muzik; drive so. ~, membuat sso bagai nak gila: his wife’s nagging drives him ~, leteran isterinya membuat dia bagai nak gila; go ~ with /fear, grief, etc/, bagai nak gila krn /takut, sedih, dll/; like ~, (sl) bagai nak gila: he had to work like ~ to finish the book, dia terpaksa bekerja bagai nak gila utk menyiapkan buku itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
